story.title: Twenty-two drivers, one season, a thousand tiny decisions
story.text: Formula 1 is a sport of margins: a tenth in qualifying, a place gained at the start, a strategy call made in a heartbeat. Behind every Sunday there are numbers that tell the story lap times can't.
story.more: F1Web turns the official results into something you can read at a glance: who is quietly consistent, who thrives against their teammate, who leaves points on the table. No hype, just the season as it unfolds, race after race.

data.title: Open data, honest numbers
data.text: Every result on this site comes from the Jolpica API, the community-run successor of the Ergast project. No predictions, no spin: we read the official classification and look for the patterns hiding in it.
data.more: F1Web is an independent, non-commercial project, not affiliated with Formula One Management or the FIA.

cta.eyebrow: Your seat on the pit wall
cta.title: Follow a rivalry, replay a Sunday
cta.text: The season is long and there is plenty to explore. Open a driver for averages and teammate battles, or step into the calendar and relive a Grand Prix from the first corner to the flag.

pilots.heroText: Eleven teams and one title to settle. Search the grid, follow the standings and see who is carrying the momentum.

banner.title: A championship is won in the details
banner.text: Every point on this table was earned somewhere: a clean launch, a late overtake, a patient one-stop. Open a driver to see how the season is really going, beyond the standings.
banner.rules: The winner takes 25 points, followed by 18, 15, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2 and 1 down to tenth place. Sprint races reward the top eight.

races.heroText: From the first red light to the final chequered flag: street circuits, historic temples of speed and everything in between.

banner.title: Tight corners, long straights, no second chances
banner.text: Narrow street layouts punish the smallest mistake, fast sweeping bends reward bravery, and long straights are made for slipstreams. Open any race to meet the circuit: completed rounds tell how the afternoon unfolded, upcoming ones count down to lights out.
